idempotency.key_generation: No Idempotency-Key is generated for backoffice operations because the approved API contract does not require one; transition concurrency is protected by expectedFromStatus instead.
idempotency.replay_handling: Read retries refetch canonical API state. State-transition retries are explicit user actions after authoritative state refresh and never replay an assumed successful mutation.
idempotency.conflict_handling: Map CLAIM_STATE_CONFLICT and INVALID_STATE_TRANSITION to the Design System conflict state, preserve operator context, refetch claim detail, and require a new explicit transition decision.

cache_invalidation: Successful authenticateOperator establishes only the in-memory operator session and then loads protected claims explicitly.
Successful transitionClaimStatus invalidates the affected claim detail/history and the claims collection/status-filter queries that can display that claim.
401 clears protected cache and in-memory credentials before routing through operator login.
testing_notes: Exercise 900-second access-token lifecycle with no refresh endpoint and local-only logout.
Exercise claims.backoffice.read and claims.backoffice.transition presentation while proving API authorization remains authoritative.
Exercise protected evidence download without exposing raw evidence in client logs or persistent browser storage.
Exercise expectedFromStatus conflict recovery without duplicating lifecycle rules in the client.
